lanes.title: GA4
costRisks: Vendor counts can drift from first-party facts if treated as display truth.
lanes.freshnessRule: Vendor evidence must be labeled by extract or realtime/intraday state.
lanes.recommendedAction: Keep as labeled validation evidence; never promote to product truth without reconciliation.

lanes.title: PostHog
costRisks: Duplicate vendor emission can increase telemetry noise if compared as product truth.
lanes.freshnessRule: Vendor evidence only; no product readiness status should depend on live PostHog.
lanes.recommendedAction: Keep as vendor evidence and label any Debug comparison as directional.

lanes.title: DeepTracker raw events
costRisks: Retry or batching defects can duplicate guest raw events.
lanes.freshnessRule: Client batches are raw inputs; display truth requires materialized sample evidence.
lanes.recommendedAction: Keep as raw ingest; display only through snapshots or Debug evidence.

lanes.title: First-party semantic telemetry
costRisks: Vendor-first semantic paths can create parity drift if not mirrored into first-party facts.
lanes.freshnessRule: Event names must be cataloged before ingest.
lanes.recommendedAction: Keep event contract as write boundary; snapshots own display calculations.

lanes.title: Guest ingest
costRisks: Guest envelopes become expensive if admin display scans them repeatedly.
lanes.freshnessRule: Guest counts require source sample evidence before zero/live display.
lanes.recommendedAction: Keep as raw envelope and materializer input; route display through guest snapshot.

lanes.title: Identified ingest
costRisks: Identified facts can be double-counted if vendor events are treated as equal truth.
lanes.freshnessRule: Event facts are raw ledger inputs until a snapshot proves a metric.
lanes.recommendedAction: Keep as canonical first-party facts; avoid direct admin display aggregation.

lanes.title: Identity links
costRisks: Guest history is lost from UI if links are not consumed by journey snapshots.
lanes.freshnessRule: Links preserve guest lineage; old facts must not be rewritten.
lanes.recommendedAction: Use identity links for recovery/debug continuity and future journey snapshots.

lanes.title: analytics_event_facts
costRisks: Broad admin reads and client listeners over raw event facts are expensive.
lanes.freshnessRule: Raw facts are authoritative inputs, not final display metrics.
lanes.recommendedAction: Keep as ledger; remove display fallback authority in later rewire phases.

lanes.title: analytics_guest_batches
costRisks: Admin raw scans of guest batches bypass bounded guest snapshots.
lanes.freshnessRule: Display zero/live only after source sample evidence exists.
lanes.recommendedAction: Keep as source input; consume through guest snapshot and Debug details.

lanes.title: analytics_sessions
costRisks: Session truth splits from GA sessions and watch sessions if not normalized.
lanes.freshnessRule: Session metrics require a declared session definition.
lanes.recommendedAction: Keep as transport/session evidence until a session snapshot owns display counts.

lanes.title: behavioral_timeline_facts
costRisks: Timeline facts are costly if used directly by admin display instead of indexes.
lanes.freshnessRule: Timeline facts feed indexes and snapshots; display must declare derived model.
lanes.recommendedAction: Keep as behavior spine and surface only via indexes/snapshots/debug.

lanes.title: guest_tracking_indexes
costRisks: Recovered guest continuity stays hidden if indexes are never consumed by admin/debug.
lanes.freshnessRule: Indexes are read models derived from timeline facts.
lanes.recommendedAction: Use as guest continuity read model for recovery and future Admin journey modules.

lanes.title: user_journey_indexes
costRisks: Funnel metrics can duplicate raw event ratios if this read model is ignored.
lanes.freshnessRule: Journey indexes own ordered journey read models when materialized.
lanes.recommendedAction: Promote as future journey/funnel source; demote raw ratios to Debug evidence.

lanes.title: analytics_watch_sessions
costRisks: Watch metrics duplicate page-duration and event counts if not snapshot-owned.
lanes.freshnessRule: Watch time must be foreground visible engagement, not page duration.
lanes.recommendedAction: Keep as watch source; display through watch/session rollups and snapshots.

lanes.title: Purchase facts
costRisks: GA ecommerce must not override backend purchase records.
lanes.freshnessRule: Revenue uses backend transaction/server purchase facts first.
lanes.recommendedAction: Keep commerce snapshot backed by transaction truth; GA is drift evidence only.

lanes.title: Unlock facts
costRisks: Telemetry unlock events cannot become entitlement truth.
lanes.freshnessRule: Unlock metrics count server entitlement facts only.
lanes.recommendedAction: Keep unlock snapshot backed by entitlement/server facts.

lanes.title: Notification facts
costRisks: Delivery/read metrics can split between push logs, user records, and telemetry.
lanes.freshnessRule: Notification metrics need delivery/read source labels.
lanes.recommendedAction: Consolidate delivery/read snapshots; keep raw logs in Debug.

lanes.title: Support and recovery facts
costRisks: Recovery signals can stay invisible if only raw support/debug lanes read them.
lanes.freshnessRule: Support/recovery evidence must label source and confidence.
lanes.recommendedAction: Surface recovery summaries in Debug before compact Admin Analytics.

lanes.title: Admin debug route diagnostics
costRisks: Debug broad reads must stay bounded and must not be promoted to display truth.
lanes.freshnessRule: Debug shows source formulas, drift, missing samples, and route freshness.
lanes.recommendedAction: Keep as Debug-only parity/recovery surface.

lanes.title: analytics_aggregate_stats/realtime_summary
costRisks: One-minute rebuild/read model can duplicate admin snapshot registry authority.
lanes.freshnessRule: Use as legacy/fallback/evidence unless a route explicitly owns live pulse.
lanes.recommendedAction: Demote behind analytics_admin_metric_snapshots in future authority collapse.

lanes.title: analytics_admin_metric_snapshots
costRisks: Display truth splits if raw routes or realtime_summary bypass this registry.
lanes.freshnessRule: Verified snapshots require lastVerifiedAt, source metadata, and fake-zero protection.
lanes.recommendedAction: Make the canonical Admin Analytics display snapshot authority.

lanes.title: BigQuery exports
costRisks: BigQuery scans are expensive and must not be runtime/admin display truth.
lanes.freshnessRule: Completed-day exports are evidence; intraday/current-day is directional.
lanes.recommendedAction: Keep export-only; reconcile and label in Debug when used.

lanes.title: Generated readiness and score reports
costRisks: Stale reports can create false launch confidence if treated as doctrine.
lanes.freshnessRule: Generated reports are stale after 24 hours unless a contract says otherwise.
lanes.recommendedAction: Keep freshness caps and mark stale/unknown evidence explicitly.

lanes.title: Public beta release notes / Beta badge version truth
costRisks: Badge can become stale if accepted patches do not publish a note.
lanes.freshnessRule: Every accepted Phase 1 patch batch increments the badge counter exactly once.
lanes.recommendedAction: Keep as version/evidence marker; do not claim smoke or provider proof.

lanes.title: Cloud/Firebase cost truth
costRisks: Admin raw scans, realtime listeners, and scheduled rebuilds can create hidden cost.
lanes.freshnessRule: Cost evidence is local/static unless an authenticated cloud smoke is explicitly requested.
lanes.recommendedAction: Keep static cost guardrails near rewire planning; do not add provider checks by default.

issues.title: Admin Analytics still has raw realtime listener display risks
issues.description: Raw listener references found for: analytics_event_facts, analytics_guest_batches, analytics_sessions, analytics_watch_sessions. Realtime is an upgrade path, not display truth.
issues.recommendedAction: Later rewire phases should route display through analytics_admin_metric_snapshots and keep raw listeners as optional upgrades or Debug evidence.

issues.title: Admin routes/helpers still reference raw guest/event/watch data as fallback display inputs
issues.description: Snapshot-first display exists, but route/helper fallback paths still mention raw analytics collections.
issues.recommendedAction: Later phases should keep bounded Debug reads but move compact Admin Analytics display fallback to verified snapshots.

issues.title: Duplicate authority: admin_analytics_snapshot_authority
issues.description: analytics_aggregate_stats/realtime_summary vs analytics_admin_metric_snapshots currently compete. Recommended authority: analytics_admin_metric_snapshots.

issues.title: Duplicate authority: active_users
issues.description: GA4 realtime vs analytics_active_users vs analytics_event_facts vs analytics_watch_sessions currently compete. Recommended authority: analytics_admin_metric_snapshots.
issues.recommendedAction: Demote GA4 realtime, analytics_active_users, raw event/watch facts to evidence/fallback/debug paths.

issues.title: Duplicate authority: guest_users
issues.description: analytics_guest_batches vs analytics_sessions vs GA-derived estimates vs guestAnalyticsSnapshot currently compete. Recommended authority: analytics_admin_metric_snapshots.
issues.recommendedAction: Demote GA-derived estimates, raw guest envelopes to evidence/fallback/debug paths.

issues.title: Duplicate authority: journey_funnel
issues.description: analytics_event_facts ratios vs user_journey_indexes vs GA funnel evidence currently compete. Recommended authority: user_journey_indexes -> analytics_admin_metric_snapshots.
issues.recommendedAction: Demote raw event ratios, GA funnel evidence to evidence/fallback/debug paths.

issues.title: Duplicate authority: watch_time
issues.description: analytics_watch_sessions vs analytics_watch_assets vs GA/page duration currently compete. Recommended authority: watch session rollup -> analytics_admin_metric_snapshots.
issues.recommendedAction: Demote GA/page duration to evidence/fallback/debug paths.

issues.title: Vendor evidence boundary needs explicit labels
issues.description: GA4, BigQuery, or PostHog references appear near admin/display/source logic. They must remain evidence, export, estimate, validation, or Debug parity only.
issues.recommendedAction: Later phases should label vendor-derived values as estimates/evidence and ensure first-party snapshots win display truth.

issues.title: Generated report evidence has stale authority risk
issues.description: 91 generated report(s) are older than 24 hours or have no parseable generatedAtUtc. Generated reports are snapshots, not doctrine.
issues.recommendedAction: Keep stale reports capped as stale/unknown evidence until their owning generator refreshes them.
